card.name: "in" in Use in Specific Populations
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "Use" in the cross-reference "[see Use in Specific Populations (8.1)]" in drug labels. It also fires weakly on a few other nouns after "Use" or "Conservation".

modes.label: Label cross-reference
modes.description: The word "in" inside the bracketed pointer to the Use in Specific Populations section.

modes.label: Other headings
modes.description: Scattered nouns in section-style phrases, such as "use of" or a "Status" heading.
